what: When the pointer is over a list row (card), that row’s image lifts out of its place (leaving the spot empty) and sticks to the cursor center every frame with no lag, and the cursor hides. When the pointer leaves the row, the image returns to its place. Instead of pointer events, each frame compares the cursor with the row box, so it sticks even when scrolling brings a row under the cursor. data-fx-part="hover" Child elements (arrows, etc.) appear only while there is Interaction

options.block: Not attached if what is under the cursor matches this css (overlaid panel or menu) — default none

use: Case name→
note: On touch devices (no hover) nothing is attached. The following image is a position: fixed clone attached to body (z-index 5000). The clone is switched on and off instantly with display (no curve, like the original)
